verdict.rationale: QuickBooks explicitly markets giving accountants direct access to books and custom role-based access controls (up to 25 users on Advanced), which directly supports inviting an external accountant with scoped permissions. However, evidence lacks specifics on how granular the role-scoping is for an accountant-specific invite (e.g., accountant-only view vs. full custom roles) or independent confirmation of this workflow in practice. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of accountant-specific invite flow and role granularity, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the accountant access experience.
